objective: Pure StatefulExecutionRuntime contract (core) + in-memory substrate (execution) with eight operations: create_session, attach_session, execute, checkpoint, restore, inspect, cancel, terminate; durable reattach via shared store; JSON-serializable opaque checkpoints with deep-copy immutability; host-authority isolation (no credentials/provider/schedule/memory/learning); legacy registry compatibility; V1 + optional adapters without mandatory IPython.

implementation.eight_operations: create_session / attach_session / execute / checkpoint / restore / inspect / cancel / terminate implemented in both InMemoryStatefulRuntimeBase (stateful/runtime.py) and StatefulExecutionRuntime (stateful_runtime.py) — all eight are pure substrate, host retains lifecycle authority
implementation.pure_contract: core/windagent_core/contracts/stateful_execution.py defines frozen Protocol with CreateSessionRequest/AttachSessionRequest/StatefulExecuteRequest/CheckpointRequest/RestoreRequest/InspectRequest/CancelRequest/TerminateRequest and StatefulSessionHandle/SessionCheckpoint/SessionInspection — zero storage/provider/orchestration deps
implementation.host_owned_durability: Shared store dict injection simulates durable SQL; manager recreation with same store retains sessions, handles, checkpoints; attach succeeds across recreation (test_attach_after_manager_recreation_via_shared_store)
implementation.opaque_checkpoint_restore: Checkpoints deep-copy JSON-serializable runtime_state (execution_count, history); _sanitize_runtime_state strips forbidden keys; _ensure_json_serializable enforces opaque serializable; restore sanitizes poisoned checkpoints and never restores host authority
implementation.deep_copy_immutability: create_session deep-copies metadata/capabilities; execute deep-copies parameters; checkpoint stores and returns distinct deep copies (mutating returned runtime_state does not affect store); inspect returns deep-copied summary (mutating summary does not affect next inspect)
implementation.host_authority_isolation: FORBIDDEN keys: provider_credentials, credentials, api_key, secret, provider_call, provider_routing, schedule, memory_write, learning_promotion, promotion, host_authority etc; _assert_no_host_authority / host_guard rejects with ValueError 'Host authority'; schedule/memory_write/learning_promotion/provider_call all rejected and never persisted
implementation.registry_legacy: ExecutionRuntimeRegistry preserves legacy dispatch/reattach/get_status/cancel/get_result for tool/browser/local_agent/subprocess; optionally hosts StatefulExecutionRuntime via stateful_runtime property and register_stateful_runtime without breaking dispatch
implementation.adapters: StatefulV1Adapter (v1) plus PersistentPythonRuntime/WasmRuntime/ContainerRuntime/RemoteRuntime optional stubs — no mandatory IPython, fallback markers (_wasm_fallback etc) when optional deps missing
implementation.boundaries: core does not import storage; execution imports only windagent_core and stdlib; no provider routing, scheduling, memory writes, or learning promotion inside runtime
